key_layers.name: Plugin
key_layers.responsibility: One Claude Code plugin per directory

key_layers.name: Skills
key_layers.responsibility: One skill per subdirectory with SKILL.md, assets, references, evals

gotchas: plugins/*/manifest.json — must stay in sync with actual skills/ subdirectories
.claude/hooks/*.py — safety hooks, must not be removed or broken
plugins/*/skills/*/assets/ — template files consumed verbatim by Claude Code; edits affect downstream codegen in user projects
SSOT docs (READMEs, plugin docs) — must be updated whenever a plugin or skill is added/changed
sensitive_areas: assets/ directories — template files for user project codegen
manifest.json files — skill registry, must stay in sync
SKILL.md files — published to users, 500-line hard cap
evals/evals.json files — test prompts must remain runnable
README.md and plugin docs — live SSOT, update after every change

future_notes: Telegram release notification via GitHub Actions when tag pushed to main — not implemented yet
